onboarding.documentTitle: Hlawula nayiphi na ispaza ngayo nayiphi na iwalethi
onboarding.body: Yamkela iintlawulo nge-QR code kuphela. Akukho matshini wamakhadi, isebenzisa idatha encinci kakhulu, kwaye iyaqhubeka isebenza nokuba inethiwekhi iyaphela.

empty.title: Iintlawulo ziza kuvulwa kungekudala
empty.description: Le venkile isalungiselela. Zama kwakhona emva kwexeshana.

empty.title: Akukabikho ntlawulo
empty.description: Iintlawulo zivela apha kwangoko xa zifika, kwaye ifowuni yakho iyazifunda ngokuvakalayo.

empty.title: Akukho thebhu zivuliweyo
empty.description: Vula ithebhu kwispaza sakho kanye, uze uhlawule ngokuchukumisa, nokuba akukho nethiwekhi.

offline.banner: Awukho kwi-intanethi. I-AnyPay iyaqhubeka isebenza kwaye iza kuvumelanisa xa ubuyile.
